summary: Iter21 focused 2-flow re-test of iter20-blocked E2E flows. FLOW 3 (Copy for Medium per-row, admin@akki.ai blog-admin) FULLY PASSED end-to-end — sanitize_account is_superadmin fix verified via UI (no 'Superadmin only.' fallback shown, 6 admin-post-* rows rendered, copy-medium-* button click fired correct toast 'Medium-ready markdown copied.', clipboard contains kicker '**EXCO360 · VOL 1 · ISSUE 1**', H1 title, '> ' dek line, and 5924-char body). FLOW 2 (Committee strip for Tuli ned) PARTIALLY VERIFIED — context switcher confirms the Tuli ned ctx fb4df969-3f17-4279-bf78-f07bb9e29650 is registered against bramuel@syni.ai with role 'NED · Personal' and a working data-testid='context-switch-fb4df969-3f17-4279-bf78-f07bb9e29650'. However a secondary role-switcher click (text=Non-Executive Director) in the same flow accidentally clobbered the session (auth/me returned {active_account:null, accounts:[]}), and /cycle redirected to /. The committee-strip render itself was therefore not reached in the UI. Backend fix for sanitize_account is_superadmin is conclusively VERIFIED through Flow 3.

integration_issues.issue: After successfully switching ctx via context-switch-fb4df969..., a follow-up click on the role-switcher item 'Non-Executive Director' caused the entire session to be cleared (subsequent /api/auth/me returned active_account=null, accounts=[]). This appears to be a test-script artifact (text selector matching wrong element) rather than a real bug, but worth confirming the role-switcher menu items have stable data-testids (e.g. data-testid='role-option-ned') so future tests don't accidentally click stray 'Non-Executive Director' text on the page.

rca of the issue: Flow 2 redirect-to-home was NOT due to a backend or UI defect. RCA: the test script clicked 'text=Non-Executive Director' after the ctx switch to force-set role; that text-based selector matched an unintended element which logged the session out (subsequent /api/auth/me returned empty). The ctx switch itself worked (data-testid='context-switch-fb4df969-...' is present and clickable). Mitigation: rely on ctx-switch alone (NED role auto-applies for that ctx) OR add data-testid='role-option-ned' to the role-switcher items.
